decision.name: PAYLOAD_IDENTITY_WITNESS_DISTINGUISHES_WRITER_SERIALIZATION_FROM_READER_COHERENCE
decision.improvement_over_previous: A timestamp-only three-file oracle can false-green for equal-clock but different evidence; this test-only contract uses captured per-writer payload identity and an actual interleaved read. A producer lock alone cannot satisfy reader coherence.
no_network_contract: In an authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout, run unchanged full baseline first. Use tmp_path and network=False throughout; do not touch production paths.

Construct a valid FlowObservation(family='etf',metric='net_flow_usd',asset='BTC',value=100,unit='USD',effective_at_ms=T-3600000,available_at_ms=T-60000,observed_at_ms=T-60000,source='fixture',source_record_id='same-clock-reader',cadence_seconds=86400). Write its to_dict() as one JSONL line to tmp_path/input.jsonl. Set T=1800000060000.

Monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json to forward to original and record a deep-copy/canonical JSON payload keyed by thread name and output basename. Require payload A != payload B for EACH of latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json, or reject the fixture as non-discriminating.

Reader test: finish A run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=False,external_jsonl=(),as_of_ms=T); then start B with external_jsonl=(input.jsonl,) and same T. Pause B immediately AFTER its latest.json os.replace and BEFORE audit_latest.json. While B is paused, read and preserve the three persisted JSON payloads as one reader observation. Release B in finally; require both run_once calls return normally, no errors, and B's fixture appended exactly once.

Classify the captured reader triplet against each writer's recorded payloads, not timestamps: it must equal one entire completed generation (all A or all B), never B-latest with A-audit/A-anata. All three as_of_ms values equal T by construction, so timestamp equality must not be accepted as proof.

Producer P0 separately: retain corrected conditional B-wait/release-A-in-finally contract, require both returns and final three outputs equal writer B's captured payloads; distinct-clock B-final stamp remains a separate assertion. Do not equate threaded P0 with process-safety or reader proof.

Preserve per-file SHA256 fixture/overlay hashes, writer-payload SHA256, reader-triplet classification, stdout/stderr, exit codes, non-skipped counts. Targeted: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_same_clock_reader.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_output_generation.py; full: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests.
decision.expected_current_sha: SOURCE_PREDICTED_RED_NOT_EXECUTED: three independent atomic_write_json calls permit B latest with A audit/anata during B's pause. This is a test expectation, not an observed failure.
decision.acceptance: Passing writer serialization alone is insufficient. Reader-visible generation consistency requires verified coherent-read protocol or immutable manifest; same-clock payload-identity witness must pass. No Specialist code proposal or task until actual test evidence and Gemini reliability.
